name: animastor-comfyui-workflow-connector
description: Animastor ComfyUI Workflow Connector — declarative mapping core between Animastor entities (prompts, images, audio, parameters) and ComfyUI workflow JSON. Loads workflows + connectors, validates compatibility (content-sensitive sha256 + node-class checks), applies entity-keyed bindings and builds runnable workflow JSON. Zero host dependencies: fs/path/crypto only; asset directories and logger are injected by the host.
